title: ITZY: From Debut to Born to Be
description: How well do you know ITZY? Ten questions on the JYP girl group's debut, its name, its early singles and its EPs up to Born to Be.

questions.question: On February 12, 2019, ITZY debuted with a single album. What was it called?
questions.fun_fact: It held just two songs: the lead single Dalla Dalla and a second track, Want It?

questions.question: The name ITZY comes from a Korean word. What does that word mean?
questions.fun_fact: Lia has tied the name to All in us, a line the members repeat often: the idea is that ITZY already holds whatever fans hope to find.

questions.question: Which single led ITZY's first EP, released on July 29, 2019?
questions.fun_fact: It became the group's first No. 1 on Billboard's K-pop Hot 100 and picked up twelve music show trophies.

questions.question: Which ITZY single from August 2020 was described as the group's first love-themed song?
questions.fun_fact: An English version arrived in January 2021, with a music video starring 3D Zepeto avatars of the five members.

questions.question: In the Morning, also called Mafia in the Morning, was the lead single of which 2021 ITZY EP?
questions.fun_fact: The title is a nod to Mafia, the party game, and J.Y. Park is one of the song's writers.

questions.question: Which ITZY single was nominated for Best K-Pop at the 2022 MTV Video Music Awards?
questions.fun_fact: ITZY also sang it on The Kelly Clarkson Show on September 27, 2021, three days after its release.

questions.question: Which 2022 EP became ITZY's first album certified Million in South Korea?
questions.fun_fact: In the US it opened at No. 8 on the Billboard 200 with 33,000 units, the group's first album to reach the top ten there.

questions.question: Cake, a summer single from July 2023, was the lead single of which ITZY EP?
questions.fun_fact: The producing duo Black Eyed Pilseung wrote and composed it, and it took first place on Music Bank on August 11, 2023.

questions.question: Which single led ITZY's January 2024 EP Born to Be?
questions.fun_fact: Bang Hye-hyun and Lee Seu-ran wrote the lyrics, and the song won on Music Bank on January 19, 2024.

questions.question: Which ITZY member was cast by JYP Entertainment at a GOT7 fan event?
questions.fun_fact: Before the debut, she and Yuna appeared in BTS's Love Yourself highlight reel in 2017.

title: K-pop Idol MCs Through the Years
description: Idols who hosted Korea's weekly music shows from 2011 to 2024. Can you match each one to the right stage?

questions.question: Which show did IVE's Jang Won-young co-host with ENHYPEN's Sunghoon from October 2021?
questions.fun_fact: Their pairing lasted until September 2022, and Lee Chae-min then hosted alongside her until January 2023.

questions.question: Which SISTAR member co-hosted Music Bank with actor Park Seo-joon from 2013 to 2015?
questions.fun_fact: The pair took over in October 2013 from Jeong Jinwoon and Park Se-young, who had hosted since that April.

questions.question: IU was a regular host of which weekly music show from 2011 to 2013?
questions.fun_fact: Over those years her co-hosts included Jo Kwon, Lee Gi-kwang, Lee Jong-suk and Hwang Kwang-hee.

questions.question: Which SEVENTEEN member hosted Inkigayo from February 2018 to October 2019?
questions.fun_fact: He started next to Jung Chae-yeon and Song Kang, and ended his run alongside Shin Eun-soo.

questions.question: Taeyeon, Tiffany and Seohyun of Girls' Generation co-hosted which show from 2012 to 2013?
questions.fun_fact: Tiffany had already hosted the same program with Yuri, from April 2009 to July 2010.

questions.question: Which ASTRO member hosted Show! Music Core from October 2016 to February 2018?
questions.fun_fact: From April 2017 his co-host was Xiyeon, and he came back to the show for a short stint in early 2019.

questions.question: Which show did SHINee's Key host from March 2015 to April 2017, alone in his final months?
questions.fun_fact: After he left, the show turned to guest MCs, starting with EXID's Hani and Pristin's Kyulkyung and Nayoung on April 20, 2017.

questions.question: Which member of (G)I-DLE, now i-dle, hosted M Countdown from February 2021 to November 2023?
questions.fun_fact: Her co-hosts over that stretch were Nam Yoon-su, then Joohoney, then Sung Han-bin.

questions.question: Which f(x) member co-hosted Show Champion through 2013?
questions.fun_fact: From January to August 2013 she shared hosting duties with Hahm Eun-jung.

questions.question: Which ATEEZ member hosted The Show from March 2021 to March 2024?
questions.fun_fact: He started with Kim Yo-han and Weeekly's Jihan, and his set of co-hosts changed twice during those three years.

title: EXO: The XOXO Era
description: Ten questions on EXO's 2013 XOXO era: the Wolf single, the Growl repackage, the two editions, the charts and the year-end awards.

questions.question: XOXO came in a Korean edition called Kiss and a Mandarin edition called what?
questions.fun_fact: Both editions came out on June 3, 2013, and the album climbed to No. 1 on Billboard's World Albums chart.

questions.question: Wolf's full Korean title translates into English as what?
questions.fun_fact: Its sound blends dubstep into hip-hop, and its story pairs a werewolf with a beautiful woman in a tragic romance.

questions.question: Which XOXO song was the first that all twelve EXO members recorded together?
questions.fun_fact: It peaked at No. 10 on the Gaon Digital Chart and at No. 4 on Billboard's World Digital Songs chart.

questions.question: The Growl repackage, released on August 5, 2013, added how many new tracks to XOXO?
questions.fun_fact: In South Korea the original album sold over 570,000 copies and the repackage over 760,000.

questions.question: Growl's first music videos, out on August 1, 2013, show EXO performing in what kind of place?
questions.fun_fact: Styled to look like one unbroken take, they were followed on August 20, 2013 by a second set shot somewhere else.

questions.question: How many first-place trophies did Growl win on South Korean music shows?
questions.fun_fact: The wins came on Music Bank, Inkigayo, Show Champion, M Countdown and Show! Music Core.

questions.question: Growl won the Song of the Year daesang at the 2013 edition of which awards show?
questions.fun_fact: The ceremony took place on November 14, 2013 at the Olympic Gymnastics Arena, and EXO left with three awards, the most of the night.

questions.question: XOXO took which top prize at the 28th Golden Disc Awards in January 2014?
questions.fun_fact: XOXO also took an album Bonsang at that ceremony, held at Kyung Hee University in Seoul.

questions.question: Growl peaked at which position on the Gaon Digital Chart?
questions.fun_fact: It also climbed to No. 3 on both Billboard's K-pop Hot 100 and its World Digital Songs chart.

questions.question: Which SM songwriter wrote Wolf's Korean lyrics and co-composed the song?
questions.fun_fact: Kenzie also co-produced the track with Will Simms, while Zhou Weijie wrote the Mandarin lyrics.

title: K-pop Songs With a Flower in the Title
description: Ten K-pop songs with a flower in the title, from cherry blossoms and lilacs to daisies and sunflowers. How well do you know them?

questions.question: Lilac (2021) shares its name with the fifth studio album of which singer?
questions.fun_fact: Out on March 25, 2021, it draws on 1970s and 1980s disco, and IU compared the song to a typhoon in springtime.

questions.question: Which band's Cherry Blossom Ending climbs back up the Korean charts almost every spring?
questions.fun_fact: Member Jang Beom-june wrote it, and the band first became known as runner-up on Superstar K3 in 2011.

questions.question: Which boy group released Daisy in October 2020 as the lead single of its EP WE:TH?
questions.fun_fact: Members Hui and Wooseok co-wrote it, and its choreography includes a move called the Sowing Dance.

questions.question: Wind Flower (2018), the lead single of the EP Blue;s, is by which girl group?
questions.fun_fact: Moonbyul helped write it, and a Japanese version came out as a single in February 2019.

questions.question: Which Red Velvet member made her solo debut with Like a Flower in November 2024?
questions.fun_fact: SM released the song with its EP on November 26, 2024, and Irene performed it on Music Bank, Show! Music Core and Inkigayo in the days after.

questions.question: RM's Wild Flower, the title track of his album Indigo, features Youjeen of which rock band?
questions.fun_fact: It came out on December 2, 2022, and Indigo was RM's debut studio album.

questions.question: Rose led the 2021 debut EP Empathy of which EXO member?
questions.fun_fact: The song was first written in English, and the singer translated the lyrics into Korean himself.

questions.question: Sunflower, a 2022 single album, was the solo debut of which I.O.I member?
questions.fun_fact: After I.O.I's first run ended in 2017, she debuted with Weki Meki that August.

questions.question: Which singer released Flower Shower in November 2019, her first song with P Nation?
questions.fun_fact: Psy and Hyuna wrote the lyrics together, and the song later appeared on her seventh EP, I'm Not Cool.

questions.question: Jisoo's Flower blends traditional Korean melodies with elements of which region's music?
questions.fun_fact: Released on March 31, 2023, it peaked at No. 2 on both the Billboard Global 200 and the Circle Digital Chart.

title: GOT7 True or False
description: Ten true or false statements on GOT7's story, from the 2014 debut and the Japanese releases to the group's 2022 EP.

questions.question: Before GOT7, Jay B and Jinyoung debuted in 2012 as the duo JJ Project.
questions.fun_fact: The duo's single album Bounce came out on May 20, 2012, after the pair had acted in the drama Dream High 2.

questions.question: Get7 was a working name for the group before JYP settled on Got7 in December 2013.
questions.fun_fact: J.Y. Park linked the name to g.o.d: he was once meant to debut with that group, whose working name was Got6.

questions.question: GOT7's debut single, Girls Girls Girls, samples an exclamation from Wonder Girls' hit Tell Me.
questions.fun_fact: J.Y. Park wrote and composed it, and GOT7 first performed it on M Countdown on January 16, 2014.

questions.question: Got It?, GOT7's debut EP, peaked at No. 1 on South Korea's Gaon Album Chart.
questions.fun_fact: It stopped at No. 2 in Korea, but it did reach No. 1 on Billboard's World Albums chart.

questions.question: GOT7 made their Japanese debut in 2016 with the album Moriagatteyo.
questions.fun_fact: Their Japanese debut was the single Around the World on October 22, 2014. Moriagatteyo, out in February 2016, was their first Japanese studio album.

questions.question: Just Right was the lead single of GOT7's first studio album, Identify.
questions.fun_fact: Identify, released in November 2014, was led by Stop Stop It. Just Right was the title track of a separate EP in July 2015.

questions.question: J.Y. Park wrote and composed GOT7's 2016 single Hard Carry.
questions.fun_fact: Earattack and Yoogeun wrote the lyrics and composed it with Lish. GOT7 first performed it on M Countdown on September 29, 2016.

questions.question: The album Present: You includes Lullaby in Korean, English, Chinese and Japanese.
questions.fun_fact: The fourth language was Spanish, and on the 2018 album each member also has a solo song he co-produced.

questions.question: In February 2021, a month after leaving JYP Entertainment, GOT7 released the single Encore.
questions.fun_fact: It came out on February 20, 2021 through Warner Music Korea.

questions.question: GOT7's 2022 self-titled EP was led by the song Nanana.
questions.fun_fact: Released on May 23, 2022, the six-track EP followed the Got7 Homecoming 2022 FanCon held in Seoul on May 21 and 22.
